answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a secure oasis within a decentralized network, forcing agents to link unique biological traits to their identity. Like a vine strangling a host, this mechanism restricts unauthorized access by tying digital credentials to physical reality. Without a valid entropy source to bridge this river of data, an attacker must bear the massive capital cost of fabricating thousands of verified identities, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically non-viable.
